hairStyles.short: short and tousled, ending above the ears, with a soft fringe
hairStyles.bunches: in two short bunches, one each side, tied with small red bobbles
hairStyles.curly: short, full and curly, a soft round cloud of curls

styles.elf: a classic pointed elf hat that flops over a little at its tip, with a pointed zigzag brim all round in the same colour and a small gold jingle bell on the tip (not a Santa hat: no fur, no bobble)
styles.deer: a classic detective's deerstalker hat in soft checked wool, with a peak at the front and the back and its ear flaps tied up on top with a little bow
styles.bobble: a chunky knitted bobble hat with a turned up cream ribbed brim and a big fluffy cream bobble
styles.santa: a soft velvet Santa hat with a fluffy cream fur brim, its tip curling down to one side with a cream pom pom
styles.tammy: a Scottish tam o' shanter: a flat round tartan bonnet, a dark band round its brim and a pom pom on top
styles.crown: a paper Christmas cracker crown with zigzag points, a little crumpled, sitting on top of the head
styles.specs: round wire framed spectacles, like a wise old detective's
styles.stars: fun star shaped party glasses with lightly tinted lenses
styles.stripe: a long cosy knitted scarf with cream stripes, wrapped once round the neck, one fringed end hanging down the front
styles.tartan: a soft woollen tartan scarf wrapped round the neck, its fringed ends hanging down the front
styles.tinsel: a fluffy, sparkly strand of Christmas tinsel draped round the neck
styles.bow: a smart little bow tie at the collar
styles.tunic: a classic elf tunic with a pointed zigzag collar and a pointed zigzag hem, a dark brown belt with a gold buckle, and long sleeves down to the mittens
styles.jumper: a cosy chunky Christmas jumper with a cream knitted pattern of snowflakes and little trees across the chest, and ribbed cuffs and hem
styles.puffer: a puffy quilted winter jacket with a zip down the front and a soft round collar that sits low, well below the chin, so the whole face shows
styles.coat: a detective's belted trench coat with a wide collar, two rows of buttons and a tied belt, reaching the knees
styles.curly: classic elf shoes with long pointed toes that curl up into a loop, each with a little gold bell on the tip
styles.boots: chunky snow boots with fluffy cream fur cuffs and thick grippy soles
styles.wellies: shiny wellington boots up to the knees
styles.mag: a detective's magnifying glass with a metal rim and handle, its glass shining
styles.torch: a chunky torch, switched on, with a soft beam of warm light
styles.notebook: a small detective's notebook with a pencil tucked into its spiral
styles.lantern: an old fashioned lantern with a warm glowing candle inside, held by its handle
styles.satchel: a little leather clue satchel worn across the body on a strap, the bag at the hip with a buckled flap
styles.badge: a shiny star shaped detective's badge pinned on the chest

outfits.workshop: a toymaker elf's work outfit: a green elf tunic with a big tan canvas tool apron over it and a pencil in the apron pocket, a red elf hat with a golden jingle bell on its tip, maroon curly toed elf shoes, and a little wooden toy mallet in the right mitten
outfits.present: a costume that makes the elf a wrapped Christmas present: a red box round the body with a gold ribbon, and a big gold bow on the head; the arms, legs and face poke out
outfits.tree: a Christmas tree costume: a layered green fir tree all in one suit dotted with tiny baubles and a garland of little gold lights, with a gold star on top of the head; the face peeks out of the front
outfits.pudding: a round Christmas pudding costume: a big round dark brown fruity pudding body with white icing dripping over the top, and a sprig of holly with red berries on the head
outfits.snowman: a snowman costume: a round white fluffy snowball body with coal black buttons, a red knitted scarf, a little black top hat, and a carrot nose on a headband
outfits.ginger: a gingerbread costume: a gingerbread biscuit suit with white icing squiggles at the wrists and ankles and three sweet buttons down the front, and a gingerbread hood with icing trim round the face
outfits.reindeer: a cosy reindeer onesie: soft brown fleece all in one suit with a pale cream tummy patch, a hood with soft felt antlers and floppy reindeer ears, the elf's own pointed ears poking out, brown hoof slippers, and a shiny red pom pom on the hood like a reindeer's red nose
outfits.piper: a Highland piper's outfit: a red tartan kilt with a white sporran, a black jacket with silver buttons, white kilt socks, black shoes, a black glengarry bonnet with ribbons, and a set of bagpipes held under the arm
outfits.grad: graduation robes: a long black gown with gold trim, a black mortar board cap with a gold tassel, and a rolled certificate tied with a red ribbon in the right mitten
outfits.golden: a golden detective outfit: a shining gold trench coat, a gold checked deerstalker hat, golden boots, a gold star badge, and a gold magnifying glass in the right mitten
outfits.nessie: a friendly Loch Ness monster costume: a green onesie with a long neck hood topped with friendly eyes, little spikes down the back, a pale green tummy, a tail, and a blue tartan scarf
